action: Protect: account manager, early access to new ranges, volume pricing. Handle their cancellations through the account manager, not checkout friction.
Re-engage: personalised reorder reminders around their usual buying gap, bundles of products they already buy. Main pool for the retention campaign.
Onboard: second-order offer within ~30 days (the median gap between orders is 28 days), welcome series showing best-sellers.
Win back cheaply: automated email with a time-limited discount. No phone calls - low value per customer.
Order confirmation (or deposit) before dispatch; review why they cancel (product, delivery, pricing).
